senses.gloss:
मश् मश्, cl. 1. P. मशति, मशितुम्, to
hum, buzz, sound, make a noise; to be
angry; [cf. rt. मिश्.]

मष् मष् (connected with rt. 1. मुष्),
cl. 1. P. मषति, मषितुम्, to kill,
hurt, injure.

मस् 1. मस्, cl. 4. P. मस्यति, &c., to
measure, weigh; mete; to change form,
become decomposed (?) .
मस् 2. मस् = मास्, in चन्द्र-म्˚.

मास् 1. मास्, आस्, n., Ved. = मांस्, flesh,
meat.

मास् 2. मास्, आस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. मा; accord-
ing to Pāṇini and Vopa-deva used in all cases except
the nom. sing. du. pl. and acc. sing. du., according
to the lexicographers and Garga also in the nom.
sing.; inst. pl., Ved. माद्भिस्), the moon; a
month; [cf. पूर्ण-म्˚, पुष्प-म्˚; cf. also Zend
maoñh, ‘moon, month;’ maoñha, ‘moon:’ Gr.
μήν for μήνς, Ion. μείς, μήν-η, μην-ιαῖο-ς, Æol.
μῆνν-ος for μῆνσ-ος: Lat. mensis, Mena, men-
struus; Goth. mena, menoth-s: Old Germ. ma-
not: Angl. Sax. mona, monadh: Lith. menu,
‘moon;’ ménesi-s, ‘month:’ Old Slav. mese-ci,
‘moon, month.’]

मश, अस्, m. a hum, humming, buzzing; anger;
a gnat, musquito; [cf. मक्ष.]
—मश-च्छद,
अस्, m. Andropogon Serratus.
—मश-हरी, f. a
musquito-curtain (= मशक-हरी, q. v.).
मस, अस्, m. measure, weight.

माष माष, अस्, m. a bean, (the sing. is
used for the plant, the pl. for the fruit); Phaseolus
Radiatus, a valued kind of pulse having seeds marked
with black and grey spots, (अकृष्टा माषाः,
‘wild beans,’ epithet of a Ṛṣi-gaṇa, to whom Ṛg-
[]
veda IX. 86, 1. is ascribed); a particular weight of
gold, &c. = 5 Kṛṣṇalas = (1/16) Suvarṇa, (the weight
in common use is said to be about seventeen grains
troy); a cutaneous eruption resembling beans; a
fool, blockhead.
—माष-तैल, अम्, n. an oily
preparation from beans.
—माष-पर्णी, f. a kind
of leguminous shrub, Glycine Debilis (= पृश्नि-
पर्णी).
—माष-वर्धक, अस्, m. a goldsmith,
jeweler.
—माष-शराविन्, ई, m., N. of a man.
—माष-शस्, ind. after the manner of a Māṣa,
Māṣa-wise, Māṣa by Māṣa.
—माषाज्य (˚ष-
आज्˚), अम्, n. a dish of beans dressed or cooked with
ghee.
—माषाद (˚ष-अद˚) or ˚ष-आद), अस्, m.
‘bean-eater,’ a tortoise.
—माषाश (˚ष-आश˚), अस्,
m. ‘bean-eater,’ a horse.
—माषोण or माषोन
(˚ष-ऊन˚), अस्, आ, अम्, minus a Māṣa, lacking one
Māṣa; see Gaṇa Giri-nadyādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 10.

मास, अस्, अम्, m. n. (but usually m.), the moon
(cf. पूर्ण-म्˚; in this sense occurring in Ved. in
the comp. सूर्य-मासा, sun and moon, see Ṛg-veda
VIII. 83, 2, X. 64, 3, &c., where, however, मासा
may be referred to 2. मास्); a month or the twelfth
part of the Hindū year, (usually a lunar month con-
sisting of thirty Tithis; there may be also a Saura or
solar month, equal to the sun's passage through a
sign of the zodiac, a Sāvana month consisting of
thirty risings and settings of the sun, a Nakṣatra
month regulated by the lunar asterisms, and a Bār-
haspatya month depending on the motions of the
planet Jupiter; the lunar month being of two kinds,
as reckoned from the new or full moon, completes
six modes of monthly computation); (मासे, after
the lapse of a month); a symbolical expression for
the number twelve; [cf. Lat. mensi-s; Hib. mios;
Cambro-Brit. mis]
—मास-कालिक, अस्, आ, अम्,
lasting for a month, available for a month, monthly;
मासकालिकं वेतनम्, a month's wages.
—मास-
चारिक, अस्, आ, अम्, practising (anything) for a month.
—मास-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, one month old.
—मास-
ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the months; (अस्), m. a
species of gallinule (= दात्यूह).
—मास-तम,
अस्, आ, अम्, monthly [cf. अर्ध-म्˚, संवत्सर-
तम]; completing a full month (= मास-पूरण).
—मास-ताल, अस्, आ, अम्, having time measured
monthwise? (apparently applied to the sound of cym-
bals &c., which lasts a long while).
—मास-तुल्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, equal to a month or to a number of months.
मास; for ‘सूर्य-मासा’ read सूर्या-मासा.

मशक, अस्, m. (incorrectly spelt मसक), a
gnat, musquito, any fly that bites or stings [cf. मक्-
षिक]; a particular skin disease (causing dark bean-
like pustules or eruptions); a leather water-bag; N.
of a preceptor with the patronymic Gārgya (the
composer of a Kalpa-sūtra); N. of the district in
Śāka-dvīpa inhabited by Kṣatriyas.
—मशक-कुटि,
इस्, or मशक-कुटी, f. a whisk for scaring mus-
quitoes; [cf. जङ्गम-कुटी.]
—मशक-जम्भन,
अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. driving away musquitoes.
—मश-
क-वरण, a whisk for scaring musquitoes.
—म-
शक-हरी, f. a bed-curtain for protection against
musquitoes, musquito-curtains; [cf. मश-हरी.]
—मशकार्थ (˚क-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, used for
musquitoes, employed on account of musquitoes;
मशकार्थो धूमः, smoke employed for driving
off musquitoes.
मसक मसक. See मशक, col. 2.

माषक, अस्, m. a bean; a particular weight of
gold, &c. = 7 or 8 Guñjās, = according to some,
about 4(1/2) grains; (अस्, आ, अम्), amounting to or
worth a particular number of Māṣas, (at the end of
comps., cf. पञ्च-म्˚.)
मासक = मास, a month; [cf. चातुर्मासक.]
मशकावती, f., N. of a district or of a river.
मशकिन्, ई, m. Ficus Glomerata.

मशर्शार मशर्शार, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a
man in Ṛg-veda I. 122, 15.
मशुन मशुन, अस्, m. a dog.
मशुलबर मशु-लबर, N. of a place.

मषराण मषराण or मषुराण, N. of a
place.
मषि मषि, मषी. See मसि, मसी, col. 3.

मसि मसि, इस्, m. f. or मसी, f. (often
written मषि, मषी; said to be fr. rt. 1. मस्, to
measure, but thought by some to be connected with
मत्स्य, a fish, ink being originally made from
cuttle-fish), ink, a black liquid made from burnt
bones &c. and used for ink; a black powder (used
to beautify the eyes), soot, lampblack; the stalk of
the Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis; [cf. मसिका.]
—मसि-
कूपी, f. an ink-bottle.
—मसि-जल, अम्, n. ink.
—मसि-धान, अम्, ई, n. f. an ink-bottle, ink-stand.
—मसि-पण्य, अस्, m. a writer, clerk, accountant.
—मसि-पथ, अस्, m. ‘ink-path,’ a pen.
—मसि-
प्रसू, ऊस्, f. an ink-bottle; a pen.
—मसि-मणि,
इस्, f. an ink-bottle.
—मसि-वर्धन, अम्, n.
myrrh.
—मसी-जल, अम्, n. ink.
—मसी-धानी, f.
an ink-bottle, ink-stand.
—मसी-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्,
ink-coloured, black as ink.
—मस्य्-आधार, अस्, m.
an ink-receptacle, ink-bottle, ink-stand.
माषि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Māṣa.
मष्क् मष्क्. See rt. मस्क्, p. 753.

मस्क् मस्क् (according to Vopa-deva
मष्क्, cf. rt. मक्क्), cl. 1. A. मस्कते,
&c., to go, move.
मष्णार मष्णार, N. of a tract of country.

मष्मषा मष्मषा, ind. (an onomatopo-
etic word, also read मस्मसा).
—मष्मषा-कृ,
Ved. to reduce to dust, grind to powder.
मस्मसा मस्मसा. See मष्मषा, p. 752.

मसन, अम्, n. meting, measuring; hurting [cf.
rt. मष्]; a species of medicinal plant (= सोम-
राजी).

मासन मासन, अम्, n. Vernonia Anthelmin-
thica; the seed of this plant (?).

1. मस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see p. 753, col. 1),
measured; [cf. perhaps Gr. μεστός.]

मस्त 2. मस्त, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
मस्; probably connected with मस्तु below; for
1. मस्त see rt. 1. मस्), the head.
—मस्त-दारु,
उस्, m. Pinus Deodora.
—मस्त-मूलक, अम्, n.
‘root of the head,’ the neck or the upper part of it
supporting the head.
मस्ति, इस्, f. meting, measuring, weighing.
मस्ति मस्ति. See under rt. 1. मस्, p. 752.

मसमसा मसमसा, an onomatopoetic
word allied to मस्मसा.

मसरा मसरा, f. a sort of lentil or pulse
(= मसूर).

मसार मसार or मसारक, अस्, m. a sap-
phire, an emerald; N. of a place.

मासर मासर, अम्, n., Ved. a particular
made dish, a mixture of the water in which rice and
millet are boiled with yeast, grasses, &c.; (अस्), m.
the meal of parched barley mixed with sour milk or
buttermilk and covered with grass; the scum of
boiled rice, rice-gruel.

मसिक, अस्, m. a serpent's hole; (आ), f. Nyctan-
thes Arbor Tristis; [cf. मसी.]

मसिन, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 1. मस्,
Uṇādi-s. II. 49), pounded, well ground (= सु-
पिष्ट), finely pounded; (अम्), n. alliance by the
right of presenting the Piṇḍa to a common proge-
nitor (= स-पिण्डक).

मसीना मसीना, f. linseed, Linum Usita-
tissimum.
मासीन, अस्, आ, अम्, one month old; monthly.

मसुर मसुर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
मस्, Uṇādi-s. 1. 44), a sort of lentil or pulse, Ervum
Hirsutum; (आ), f. a lentil; a harlot.
—मसुर-
कर्ण, अस्, m. a proper N.

मसूर, अस्, m. a sort of pulse or lentil, Ervum
Hirsutum, Cicer Lens (= मङ्गल्यक); a pillow;
(आ), f. the preceding lentil; a harlot; (ई), f. erup-
tion of pimples or pustules, a kind of small-pox;
Ipomœa Turpethum (= त्रि-वृत्); = रक्त-त्रिवृत्.
—मसूर-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of his posterity.
—मसूर-बिदला or म-
सूर-विदला, f. Impomœa Turpethum; Ichnocarpus
Frutescens (the seeds of which resemble a split lentil);
(perhaps) a split lentil.
—मसूर-सङ्घाराम, अस्,
m., N. of a Buddhist monastery.

मासूर मासूर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मसूर), of
the shape of a lentil, lentil-shaped; consisting or
made of lentils or pulse.

मसूरक, अस्, m. a pillow; (इका), f. eruption of
lentil-shaped pustules, small-pox; a procuress; a
musquito-curtain; (अम्), n. a kind of ornament on
Indra's banner.

मसुरक्षित मसु-रक्षित, अस्, m., N. of a
king.

मसूस्य मसूस्य, अम्, n., Ved. a kind of
grain growing in some northern country.

मसृण मसृण, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
1. मस्), soft, tender, smooth; bland, mild, unctuous,
shining; (= कर्कश), hard?; (आ), f. linseed, Linum
Usitatissimum.

मसृणित, अस्, आ, अम्, softened, smoothened,
polished.

मस्कर मस्कर, अस्, m. a bamboo; a hollow
bamboo cane.
मस्ज् मस्ज्. See rt. मज्ज्, p. 729.

मस्तक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the head, the skull;
the summit or highest peak of a mountain, top of
a tree, the head or top or upper part of anything
(e. g. चुल्ली-मस्तकम् आरोप्य, having placed on
the top of the hearth); the tuft of leaves which
grows at the top of various species of palm trees; a
particular formula used by Śaivas.
—मस्तक-ज्वर,
अस्, m. ‘head-fever,’ head-ache.
—मस्तक-पिण्डक,
अस्, अम्, m. n. a round protuberance on the temples
of an elephant in rut.
—मस्तक-मूलक, अम्, n.
= मस्त-मूलक, q. v.
—मस्तक-लुङ्ग, the
membrane of the brain.
—मस्तक-शूल, अम्, n.
sharp or shooting pain in the head, head-ache.
—मस्तक-स्नेह, अस्, m. ‘head-marrow,’ the brain.
—मस्तकाख्य (˚क-आख्˚), अस्, m. the top of a tree.
मस्तिक, अम्, n. = मस्तक, the head.

मस्तिष्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (incorrectly spelt मस्-
तिस्क), the brain; any medicine or substance acting
upon the brain; [cf. Slav. moζjd.]
—मस्तिष्क-
त्वच्, क्, f. the membrane surrounding the brain
(दुर मतेर्?).
मस्तिष्क मस्तिष्क. See above.

मस्तु, उ, n. the upper part of thickened sour milk,
sour cream; the watery part of curds, whey.
—मस्तु-
लुङ्ग or मस्तु-लुङ्गक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the
brain; [cf. मस्तक-लुङ्ग.]
—मस्त्व्-आमिक्षे, f.
du. whey and curds.
मस्तु मस्तु. See above.
मस्मा मस्मा, f. a proper N.

माशब्दिक माशब्दिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मा-
शब्दः, see 1. मा), commanding silence, prohibi-
tive, prohibiting; a prohibitor, forbidder.

माषशरावि, इस्, m. a patronymic, (probably fr.
माष-शराविन्.)

माषीण, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with beans; (अम्), n.
a bean field, a field producing black kidney-beans.

माष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fitted or suited for beans
(= माषीण); amounting to or worth a particular
number of Māṣas, (used in this sense at the end of
comps. after numerals, &c., cf. द्वि-म्˚, अध्यर्ध-
म्˚); (अम्), n. a field of kidney-beans.

मास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of comps.) a month
old, lasting or continuing a month.

—मास-त्रय, अम्, n. three months.
—मासत्र-
यावधि (˚य-अव्˚), ind. for the space of three
months.
—मास-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be paid or
discharged in a month (as a debt).
—मास-धा,
ind. by the month, monthly.
—मास-पाक, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. maturing or producing results in a month.
—मास-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, a month before, a month
earlier, (in this sense पूर्व has not the pronominal
declension.)
—मास-प्रमित, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘measured
by months,’ occurring once a month; (अस्), m. new
moon.
—मास-प्रवेश, अस्, m. the beginning of a
month.
—मासप्रवेशानयन (˚श-आन्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of an astronomical work.
—मास-भुक्ति, इस्, f.
the (sun's) monthly course; [cf. पक्ष-भुक्ति.]
—मास-मान, अस्, m. a year.
—मास-वर्त्तिका,
f. a species of wagtail (= सर्षपी).
—मास-शस्,
ind. by the month, monthly, month by month; for
months.
—मास-सञ्चयिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having
provisions for a month.
—मास-स्तोम, अस्, m., Ved.,
N. of an Ekāha.
—मासाधिप (˚स-अध्˚), अस्, and
Ved. मासाधिपति (˚स-अध्˚), इस्, m. the regent
or planet presiding over a month.
—मासानुमा-
सिक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. मास + अनु-मास), performed
from month to month, monthly.
—मासान्त (˚स-
अन्˚), अस्, m. the end of a month, day of new moon.
—मासापवर्ग (˚स-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. con-
tinuing a month at the most.
—मासावधिक (˚स-
अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a month as the limit, happen-
ing in the period of a month at the latest.
—मासा-
हार (˚स-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, taking food only once
a month.
—मासोपवास (˚स-उप्˚), अस्, m. fasting
a whole month.
—मासोपवासिनी (˚स-उप्˚), f. a
woman who fasts a whole month; (ironically) a
lascivious woman, procuress.
मासल, अस्, m. a year.

मासुरकर्ण मासुरकर्ण, अस्, m. a patro-
nymic from Masura-karṇa.
मासुरी मासुरी, f. a beard.
